From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, caroline@acme-retail.com, ben.holt@cloudproc.io
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-QBR cross-functional action tracker & gating questions

Team — looping you in early so we have a single source of truth for QBR readiness. I pulled together the initial action tracker (attached) and flagged the items I want leadership to be able to confirm at the QBR: GTM play, enablement content, pricing approvals, docs freeze, support runbooks and escalations.

High-level asks (please update tracker by EOD Thu 6/17):
- GTM: confirm final launch cohort + go-live comms owner (owner: marissa_cole)
- Enablement: content freeze + classroom schedule (owner: marissa_cole)
- Pricing: signoff on redlines; we need finance approver for the contract term (owner: laura_bennett)
- Docs: final staging push and doc freeze window (owner: karthik_iyer)
- Support: runbook + escalation contacts (owner: vivek_kulkarni)

Blocking items I flagged in the tracker: pricing redlines (see attached pricing-final-draft.pdf), enablement TOC gaps, and a missing on-call coverage window during launch weekend. I also added a short risk/impact column so we can quickly surface top 3 risks at the QBR.

Attachments: qbr_action_tracker.xlsx, pricing-final-draft.pdf
Shared sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QBR-Action-Tracker

Can Caroline and Ben confirm whether any partner-specific comms are required from their side (Caroline for Acme retail; Ben for Marketplace listing)?

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Aditya — thanks for pulling this together. A couple of clarifying items from finance/commercial: 
- We need an explicit approver from finance for the pricing redlines (I recommend Ben Holt as the commercial finance approver for the Acme opportunity). Ben — can you confirm availability to review and sign off by 6/16?
- Also want to flag margin sensitivity on the proposed discounts; if marketing/PLG wants to push larger promotional credits we'll need to model FY27 impact.

Other ask: can support provide the on-call rotation for the launch weekend by EOD 6/16 so we can capture it in the QBR slides? Vivek — looping you for confirmation.

I'll reserve 10 minutes in the QBR to call out the pricing decision and escalation readiness.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations

- Enablement: Marissa to finish instructor guide 6/18; content freeze 6/19.
- Pricing: Laura to get finance approver confirmation by 6/16; if approved we move pricing to "green".
- Docs: Karthik confirmed migration 6/19 02:00 PT (30m).
- Support: Vivek to confirm on-call rotation by EOD 6/16.
